description:
I'm Earl Whitaker. I spent 32 years with the Dayton Fire Department, the last twelve as a fire inspector, walking into homes after the worst had already happened.

Most house fires I saw started with something small and ordinary: a frayed extension cord under a recliner, a dryer vent nobody cleaned, a smoke alarm with a dead battery. Almost every one of them could have been stopped for a few dollars and twenty minutes on a Saturday.

On this channel I show you exactly what I checked in those homes and the cheap, simple fixes that actually work — no expensive systems, no scare tactics, no products to sell you. Just what a retired firefighter would tell his own mother.

New videos every week. If someone you love lives alone, subscribe — these are the things nobody tells them.

This channel is for general educational purposes and is not a substitute for a professional fire inspection.
